contract_defense: The contract worth pricing over an 8 to 12 week horizon is SR3H7, the March 2027 three-month SOFR future, settlement observation 2026-11-05, implied rate 4.24, price 95.76, and price = 100 - implied rate checks. That horizon reaches the 2026-12-09 US decision (effective 2026-12-10) and, at the long end, the 2027-01-27 decision (effective 2027-01-28). SR3H7 is still the next full quarterly period through that window. The live action is still flat: the 5 November coupon rally is real, and neither a further receive nor a tactical pay is identified. DV01 uses the SR3 convention USD 25 per bp per 1m notional, dv01 = 25 * (notional/1_000_000). The scale note against a 10,000-per-bp-per-100m identity is in the memo and is stated once there.
why_not_the_other_contracts: SR3Z6, expiry 2026-12, implied rate 4.115, price 95.885, observation 2026-11-05, is declined. It is one quarterly period, and it is the wrong risk for the 2-year yield at 446 bp (4.46 percent). The 2-year fell 12 bp on 2026-11-05; this map has no SR3 history, so that coupon day is not a December-future move. An 8 to 12 week hold also runs past the December expiry label, so the contract stops being a clean forward inside the horizon. SR3M7 at 4.335 and SR3U7 at 4.365 are later quarterly periods. Using them would extend the path through the 2027-03-17, 2027-06-09, and 2027-09-15 decision dates after meeting-price levels were removed. Quarantined SR1 rows are one-month futures quotes and are not a meeting-step path and not this expression. The cash 2-year is not the exchange contract.
labor_and_inflation_limits: US.Labor.payrolls, unemployment, and wages are observation_period 2026-09, research_status current release. The US labor temperature score, label temperature_score_not_a_raw_print and not_consensus true, is level 51.26, impulse -1.54, direction cooling, class neutral, as_of 2026-09, near the lineage anchor of 50. That is a score, not a print and not a consensus. There is no November employment-situation print and no October print in the component rows. Chicago Fed labor rows exist around 2026-10, and initial claims are observation 2026-10-31, without numeric values in those rows. US.Inflation.core_pce is source_failed, previous release retained, period 2026-07; the inflation score is level 63.1, impulse -0.81, direction static, class warm, as_of 2026-07. CPI core is a 2026-09 current row with no numeric value in the row. CA labor components are source_failed / unavailable. The four scenarios below are conditional stories about how the curve would be wrong.

conditional_scenarios.us_employment_strong: If the missing US employment report were strong, the curve that would be wrong is the 5 November front-end rally as a growth path. SR3H7 at 4.24 would be too low, and the declined receive would be the expression that lost. A settle at or above 4.53, 29 bp above 4.24, is the pre-registered level for that story. It is the net US 2-year decline across the last 20 observations (475 bp on 2026-10-08 to 446 bp on 2026-11-05), used as a proxy because no SR3 strip history exists. This is not a forecast of the report.
conditional_scenarios.us_employment_weak: If the missing US employment report were weak, the curve that would be wrong is the residual gap between SR3H7 at 4.24 and the 2026-11-04 overnight SOFR fixing at 3.94. That 30 bp gap is a difference between a quarterly period path and an overnight fixing. A weak report would say the period path was still high. The declined pay would be the expression that lost if the implied rate fell to 3.94. This is not a forecast, and the gap is not carry and not a hike count.
conditional_scenarios.ca_employment_strong: If Canadian employment were strong, the curve story that would be wrong is a continental growth shock used to receive SR3H7. Canadian labor components are source_failed, so this story has no current Canadian print behind it. A strong Canadian outcome would leave the US March period to be judged on US evidence. This node does not turn that conditional into a Canada rates order.
conditional_scenarios.ca_employment_weak: If Canadian employment were weak, the curve story that would be wrong is a purely domestic fade of the US rally. A weak Canadian outcome would be consistent with a broader growth reading and would make the declined pay the expression that was early. The components that would support that reading are unavailable, so the conditional does not fill the hole and does not identify SR3H7.

decomposition.currency: No currency expression is used. The broad dollar series ends 2026-10-30 and is not a 5 November confirmation.
decomposition.liquidity: Williams's 5 November headline says the Fed should gather information on price risks. The September central-bank notes in the map do not state a funds-rate path. Neither is a liquidity edge in SR3H7.
decomposition.financing: ACT/360 at 3.94 percent on the 10000 dollar study draw for 70 days is about 76.61 dollars. The charge is on the draw, not on notional, and it is not a directional edge.

decomposition.path: 4.24 is the priced March quarterly path. The 30 bp distance to the 3.94 overnight fixing is not cheapness, not carry, and not a hike count. Targets 4.08 to 4.12 are a judgmental band the size of a 16 bp and a 12 bp proxy daily move. Adverse 4.53 is 4.24 plus the 29 bp net US 2-year decline over the last 20 observations. Gap stress 4.70 is 4.24 plus the 46 bp distance from the 2026-11-05 2-year at 446 bp to the history maximum of 492 bp on 2026-09-28. The proxy is not an SR3 strip.

decomposition.policy: A tactical pay needs the front-end rally to be too far for the reaction function. Meeting prices are out, and the Williams headline is an instruction to gather information on price risks. That headline does not price a higher March period.
decomposition.growth: The pay is the fade. Equity declines the same day, a Nasdaq history-low close, and a cooling activity score for 2026-10 (level 50.77, impulse -3.59, still a score) are the ways the fade is early. One day does not separate growth stress from an overreaction.
decomposition.inflation: A warm, stale inflation score and an oil rebound are the inflation facts in the map. They are not a measured cheapness of 4.24. Breakevens moved about 2 bp on the day.
decomposition.energy: The oil rebound can support a price-risk story and can also be the bounce after the 4 November drop. It does not identify an overreaction in SR3H7.
decomposition.liquidity: Headlines describe Treasury buying ahead of jobs data and AI-linked credit stress. Those are headlines. HY OAS at 332 bp is as of 2026-11-04 and is not a 5 November print.
decomposition.financing: Same ACT/360 charge as the receive study row, about 76.61 dollars on a 10000 dollar draw for 70 days. Not an edge for the short.
decomposition.horizon: Same 8 to 12 weeks. The pay is on SR3H7 so it is the same period as the receive, not a December substitute for the 2-year.
decomposition.path: Adverse level is 3.94, on the losing side, 30 bp below 4.24. That level is the overnight fixing, used as the distance at which the leads' above-cash description is gone. It is not a forecast that the future converges to the fixing. Gap stress 3.78 is that fixing minus 16 bp, the largest absolute daily US 2-year proxy move. Targets 4.36 to 4.40 are a 12 bp to 16 bp judgmental backup, the size of the 5 November 2-year decline and of that proxy tail. They are not fair value.

candidates.hurts_when: no open risk; a receive would be hurt if the implied rate rises, a pay if it falls
candidates.wait_trigger: Stay flat in SR3H7 until the employment report the headlines describe is actually in evidence, or until a later SR3H7 settle is at or above 4.53 or at or below 3.94. Those two levels are the declined receive's adverse and the declined pay's adverse. They are review points, not an order to trade the print in advance.
candidates.cost_of_waiting: The financing draw is 0, so the ACT/360 charge at 3.94 percent for 70 days is 0. The market cost of waiting is that SR3H7 can move with no position. A 12 bp move, the 5 November US 2-year proxy day, is 3000 dollars at the 10m compare notional under the 25-per-bp-per-1m convention. That scale is not carry, and waiting does not earn the 30 bp gap to the fixing.
candidates.falsifier: The wait is wrong if SR3H7 settles beyond 4.40 or through 4.08, a 16 bp proxy-tail either way, while the employment evidence is still absent and the US 2-year daily proxy moves the same way. It is also wrong, after the fact, if the missing report arrives and the March contract then reprices through 4.53 or 3.94.
candidates.practical_exit: There is no position to exit. The practical act is to keep the book flat in this US quarterly future and to reopen the question on new labor evidence or at the 4.53 and 3.94 review levels.

decomposition.policy: Policy inference stays coarse. Derived meeting prices are out because the front Fed meeting estimate was flagged as about 8 bp wrong, and that warning is not applied as an 8 bp repair. Calendars remain dates only.
decomposition.growth: The growth trade would be the receive. The same-day equity drop, the multi-week coupon rally, the near-anchor September labor score, and the missing employment print do not line up into one practical receive.
decomposition.inflation: The inflation trade would lean on the pay. The inflation evidence is a stale warm score, a 2 bp breakeven decline, and an oil rebound. That is not an overreaction fade.
decomposition.energy: Oil up and growth stress coexist on 2026-11-05. The energy print does not choose the side.
decomposition.currency: No currency book is re-opened. The dollar series is not contemporaneous with 5 November.
decomposition.liquidity: Headline liquidity and credit stories are noted and not converted into a SOFR position.
decomposition.financing: Zero draw. The financing rate remains the 2026-11-04 SOFR fixing at 3.94 percent, ACT/360, and it finances nothing.
decomposition.horizon: 8 to 12 weeks is the horizon over which March is the right contract to have priced, and over which the honest position is no position.

objections: The trend-follower add treats the coupon rally and the gap to the overnight fixing as a reason to receive SR3H7. There is no SR3 strip history to show that March lagged the coupons.
The rate-hawk open uses SR3Z6 as the bookable stand-in for the 2-year. December is a different quarterly period, and the 2-year move is not a December-future move in this map.
The 30 bp gap from 4.24 to the 3.94 fixing is a difference of objects. It is not leftover carry and not a count of hikes.
A one-day equity decline does not name the cause of the yield decline. Oil rebounded the same day, and the coupon rally had already been underway.
Derived meeting-price estimates stay excluded. The about-8 bp warning is not inverted into a corrected meeting price.
